description: This file defines the DayOfMonthField class, which extends AbstractField. The class handles scheduling logic specific to day-of-month expressions in cron jobs, including the special handling of 'last day', 'nearest weekday', and validation of cron expression syntax.

classes.name: DayOfMonthField
classes.description: A class for evaluating day-of-month conditions in cron expressions, including handling special characters like 'L', 'W', and '?'.

methods.name: getNearestWeekday
methods.description: Private static method that calculates the nearest weekday to a given day in the current month and year.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if a given date satisfies the cron day-of-month expression, including handling special characters.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Advances or rewinds the date by one day, depending on the invert flag, adjusting the time accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the provided cron value for the day-of-month field matches allowed characters/pattern.
